verdict.rationale: An error-tracking service could publish an OpenAPI spec, so this axis applies. However, probes of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404, and no doc describes a downloadable machine-readable API spec. The claim of Sentry API compatibility and the MCP server are adjacent capabilities, not a published spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
